## Metric definitions

| Metric | Effective inherited/registered definition |
| --- | --- |
| fault_window_horizontal_rmse_m | Inherited unchanged P-09c value over start <= t <= end; both interval endpoints included. |
| post_window_horizontal_rmse_m | Inherited unchanged P-09c value over t > end. |
| outage_end_horizontal_error_m | horizontal_err_m from full-rate sealed error_series at the last matched evaluation epoch t with outage_start_s <= t < outage_end_s; no interpolation to endpoint; unavailable if no matched epoch or that last epoch is nonfinite. Record selected time and full-rate source sha256. |
| max_horizontal_error_in_window_m | Maximum horizontal_err_m over all matched evaluation epochs t with outage_start_s <= t < outage_end_s in full-rate sealed error_series; unavailable if no epochs or any in-window value nonfinite; not maximum of the 10 Hz display sample. |

[Metric wording erratum](clean6/ADDENDUM_METRIC_WORDING_ERRATUM.md) preserves the original contract wording alongside the inclusive inherited fault-RMSE endpoint and half-open new derived-metric endpoints. The erratum changes no numerical operation.

No NAV, error-series metric, bootstrap interval, Wilcoxon statistic, or hypothesis decision was recomputed by this report generator. The source aggregates retain the original native/evaluator outcomes and explicit unavailable fields.
